briefings.title: CVE-2026-63077: JetBrains TeamCity actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: JetBrains TeamCity contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated remote code execution via the agent polling protocol.

briefings.title: CVE-2026-18556: N-able N-central actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that allows for authentication bypass.

briefings.title: CVE-2026-34486: Apache Tomcat actively exploited
briefings.excerpt: Apache Tomcat contains a missing encryption of sensitive data vulnerability that allows the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE‑2025‑24813.
